events.name: Bash
events.head: Check clean worktree state
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t191-wt 2>/dev/null && { git fetch -q origin && git status --short | head; git log -1 --format='%h %s'; git rev-parse --short origin/main; git merge-base --is-ancestor 9ea3b9a0 origin/main && echo HAS9ea; } || echo NO_WT

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check origin/main and worktree list
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git rev-parse --short origin/main && git merge-base --is-ancestor 9ea3b9a0 origin/main && echo HAS9ea; git worktree list | grep -i t191; ls cloud/scripts/build.sh; grep -n DAY_HOURS cloud/src/plan.ts | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create clean worktree at origin/main, view build script
events.input: $ git worktree prune && git worktree add -q --detach /private/tmp/t191-wt origin/main && cd /private/tmp/t191-wt && git log -1 --format='%h %s' && git status --short | wc -l && cat cloud/scripts/build.sh | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Link node_modules and run Worker tsc
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t191-wt && for d in app cloud; do [ -e $d/node_modules ] || ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/$d/node_modules $d/node_modules; done; [ -e node_modules ] || { [ -d /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/node_modules ] && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/node_modules node_modules; }; cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc=$?; cd /private/tmp/t191-wt && git status --short

events.name: Bash
events.head: Build the revops-centre Worker assets
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t191-wt && bash cloud/scripts/build.sh > /tmp/t191-build.log 2>&1; echo build=$?; tail -5 /tmp/t191-build.log

events.text: Build failed because Turbopack refuses symlinked node_modules; switching to real copies (APFS clone) and rebuilding.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Clone app node_modules and rebuild
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t191-wt && rm app/node_modules && cp -cR /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && bash cloud/scripts/build.sh > /tmp/t191-build.log 2>&1; echo build=$?; tail -4 /tmp/t191-build.log; git status --short | head
